_comment: Chronos per-agent tick hook for OpenAI Codex. Copy to ~/.codex/hooks.json (global) or <repo>/.codex/hooks.json (per-project). Codex's hook config is Claude-compatible JSON. NOTE: Codex only runs PostToolUse for SHELL commands today (not Edit/Write/Read) — so Codex ticks cover shell/exec actions; file edits won't fire a PostToolUse tick. chronos-hook auto-detects the agent (codex) by process ancestry, so no agent name is needed here.
